Messages.Author: Jon Stahler
Messages.Body:
Are multiple couriers cumulative? In other words, if I have five in play,
can I tap all 5 to make my prey discard his next 5 cards on successful
bleed? Thanks in advance.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. You tap each one in turn to discard the successive "top" cards
